note: Generated by vm/truth/mk_labels.py. Shared OS side effects: state Windows writes during any install, launch or uninstall that no uninstaller should remove and no tool can attribute. Included by every app label file. Ambient rules run before per-app rules (except `first` rules), so every pattern is anchored under a Windows-owned root.

rules.label: ambient
